how.label: How it works
how.title: Three steps. One link.
how.s1b: Paste a brief or a client message. AI drafts priced lines, and you edit them.
how.s2b: WhatsApp, email or Slack. It opens on any phone, with no account.
how.s3b: Your client says yes or no to each line, signs once, and pays through your link.

why.label: Why it works
why.title: The price is already on the page.
why.sub: So you never have to bring it up.
why.t1b: Paste their message, set a price, send. They see exactly what changed and tap Approve.
why.t2t: Line by line, not all or nothing
why.t2b: Every item gets a yes, or a no with a reason. Questions come up now, not at handover.
why.t3b: Who approved what and when, with a fingerprint anyone can verify.
why.t4b: Add your own pay link. SignedScope never holds or moves your money.

items.a: SignedScope gives you a clear record: who approved which lines, when, their drawn or typed signature, and a SHA-256 fingerprint anyone can check. Many places accept electronic records like this for service work, but rules differ. For large contracts, check your local rules or ask a lawyer.

items.q: Does my client need an account?
items.a: No. They open the link on any device, approve each line and sign.

items.q: What happens when the client asks for more?
items.a: Paste their message, set a price, and send a change request. They see what changed against the signed version and approve or reject it.
The Pay button opens your own Stripe, Wise, PayPal, Payoneer or Omise link, or shows your bank details. SignedScope never holds or moves your money.

items.q: What does the AI do with my brief?
items.a: It drafts priced lines for you to edit. The text goes to our AI provider, Anthropic, only to write the draft. The privacy page has the details.
Yes. We renamed it. Links you already sent still work.
